criteria.text: money.split_amount(cents, parts) returns shares that always add up to the total, with the left-over cents given one each to the first shares: split_amount(100, 3) is [34, 33, 33]. It raises ValueError when parts is below 1.
The whole test suite passes, and it has tests for this change that fail on the code as it was before the change.
CHANGELOG.md has a new bullet under 'Unreleased' that describes this change.
